title: Anatomical position
summary: Identify anatomical left/right, proximal/distal, medial/lateral, and anterior/posterior on the human body.
task: View the radius and ulna in anatomical position. Rotate the arm and compare the lateral radius with the medial ulna.

title: Axial skeleton
summary: Learn the bones of the skull, vertebral column, and thoracic cage.
task: Inspect the anterior and posterior skull, then isolate the sternum and identify the uppermost cervical vertebrae.

title: Appendicular skeleton
summary: Work proximally to distally through the shoulder, arm, hip, thigh, and leg.
task: Pull the femur from the lower limb; identify where it articulates with the pelvis and tibia.

title: Rotator cuff and shoulder
summary: Examine the deltoid and the four rotator-cuff muscles of the shoulder.
task: Select and move the deltoid to expose deeper shoulder anatomy. Some source meshes may be combined.

title: Peripheral nerves
summary: Follow named peripheral nerves through the limbs.
task: Isolate a nerve and rotate around it to understand its course relative to the limb.

title: Thoracic and abdominal organs
summary: Explore the topographic relations of thoracic and abdominal organs.
task: Pull organs away from the body and view their positions from the anterior and posterior perspectives.
